# A flag a command does not read is REFUSED, not ignored.
#
# breeze has one shared flag parser, so every flag is syntactically valid on every
# command — which meant each command silently dropped the ones it did not read.
# `--set` on `run pipeline` parsed cleanly, was never read, and the stage then
# refused as though nothing had been supplied; the reporter spent two retries on
# the VALUE, because accepted-and-dropped is indistinguishable from
# accepted-and-wrong. Every flag in that parser was read at 2-5 of ~25 commands,
# so --set was the instance with consequences rather than the only instance.
env BREEZE_DIR=$WORK/state

exec breeze register identity admin
cp stdout admin.token
exec breeze apply -f pipeline.hcl --as admin --token-file admin.token

# The reported shape, on a command that genuinely has nothing to do with --set.
! exec breeze show pipeline demo --set FOO=bar
stderr 'does not read --set'
stderr 'silently ignored'
# The refusal names the command and what it DOES accept, so the fix is in the
# message rather than in a second command.
stderr 'breeze show pipeline'
stderr 'accepts --json'

# Subcommand granularity is the point: --set is real on `start stage` and
# meaningless on `approve stage`, and one shared parser cannot tell them apart.
! exec breeze approve stage demo review abc123 --set FOO=bar --as admin --token-file admin.token
stderr 'does not read --set'

# Flags a command DOES read still work.
exec breeze show pipeline demo --json
stdout '"name":\s*"demo"'

# Credentials are accepted everywhere, including where they are not read: people
# pass --as/--token-file uniformly across a script, and an unread credential
# changes no behaviour. Refusing them would break working invocations to prevent
# nothing.
exec breeze ps --as admin --token-file admin.token
stdout 'identities'

# --help still short-circuits to usage, and an unknown flag is still a hard error.
exec breeze show pipeline --help
stdout 'usage: breeze show pipeline'
! exec breeze show pipeline demo --nope
stderr 'unrecognized flag'

exec breeze stop

-- pipeline.hcl --
pipeline "demo" {
  stage "build" {
    type    = "command"
    timeout = "10s"
    command = ["/bin/true"]
  }
  stage "review" {
    type               = "approval"
    required_approvals = 1
    approver_role      = "reviewer"
  }
}
